messages:
alex: Starting a config-only deploy now to adjust routing weights and per-tenant rate limits. Canary at 5% for config v2026-03-18-shaper. Change window 20m. tagging @maria @jit for monitoring

deploy-bot: deploy started: service=config-router rollout=canary target=5% config=v2026-03-18-shaper initiator=alex

maria: watching canary dashboards. I see a small tail latency bump on region-us-east-1, nodepool r1-canary around 30s after start. not huge but visible :thinking_face:

jit: logs from canary: ``
WARN routing: backpressure triggered for tenant=acct-9 weight=0.6 -> queued=42
WARN batching: max_batch_wait_ms exceeded=120
``

maria: hm looks correlated with new per-tenant limit (acct-9). can we pin that tenant to previous routing policy while we debug?

alex: yes. recommend pin for acct-9 to routing-policy v2.4 and hold canary there. doing pin now.

alex: `releases pin --service routing --tenant acct-9 --version v2.4 --reason "mitigate tail latency spike"`

ops-bot: action recorded: pin applied tenant=acct-9 version=v2.4 by=alex

jit: after pin: tail latency for acct-9 back to baseline. but other small errors 502 from some inference pods; could be batching/timeouts interaction.

maria: 502s are coming from a subset of model-serving hosts (ms-12, ms-14). rolling canary at 5% still, but error rate bumped to 1.8% (alert threshold 1%).

alex: given the error spike, I propose aborting the canary and rolling back the config fully. rollback -> last known-good v2026-03-10-shaper. anyone object?

deploy-bot: rollback initiated: service=config-router from=v2026-03-18-shaper to=v2026-03-10-shaper initiated_by=alex

ops-bot: alert suppressed: canary error rate > threshold, automated rollback in progress

maria: confirm: rollback completed on all regions. verifying metrics now.

deploy-bot: rollback completed at 1755010122. status=success affected=all-regions

jit: verification: error rate back to baseline, tail latency stabilized. per-tenant pin remains for acct-9 (v2.4) until we follow up.

alex: filing follow-up RFC and adding a postmortem note to the release thread. quick summary: attempted config-only shaper -> caused backpressure and 502s from batching/timeouts on some model hosts; pinned acct-9 mid-canary; aborted and rolled back to v2026-03-10-shaper. next steps: reproduce on staging with ms-12/ms-14 traffic shape, test batching timeout combos, and update release notes. link: https://redwood.internal/releases/notes/2026-03-18-config-shaper

rachael: thanks all for fast responses. I'll create the tracking ticket and assign to eng-runtime to investigate batching-timeout interplay. adding follow-up meeting tomorrow 11am PT. :calendar:

alex: closing change window. postmortem + action items expected in the ticket. thanks! :thumbsup:
